name: workspace
//: The workspace root: it owns every file no other project does (toolchain, lockfiles, justfile, docs, schemas, CI), so a change there runs the broader tier. It also owns the repository's scripts (install.sh, scripts/) and their offline bats suite (tests/), so it carries the shell targets: shfmt (format, format-check), shellcheck and actionlint (lint), the offline suite under bashcov (test). Its other targets are the repo-level ones: the aggregate Rust and shell coverage, the supply-chain audit, the MSRV build, and the root-file drift checks. It depends on the crates and the shell suites whose reports the coverage aggregate merges, and on the shell helpers its suite loads, so a change to any of them reruns it.

dependsOn.//: llmlint: ignore[expensive_tests_stay_behind_their_own_edge] JSON has no comment to scope this to the line below. The shell floor is enforced once, over the merge of every shell project's report, as AGENTS.md requires of the Rust floor (whose suites this aggregate reruns above on every change that selects it): merging without onejudge-scripts-e2e's report would fail the floor on lines only its journeys reach, so the aggregate's edge to that suite is the measurement's own. It costs about 24s beside the instrumented Rust suites; the suite stays out of the offline workspace:test.
